away.summary: The Bruins (1-0-0) are projected to dress the same lineup that secured a 3-0 win over the New York Rangers in their season opener. Jeremy Swayman is expected to start in goal, with Michael DiPietro as backup. Key absences include suspended defenseman Charlie McAvoy (serving a six-game suspension) and injured forward Matthew Poitras (lower body), while forwards Michael Eyssimont and Frederic Brunet are scratched.

home.summary: The Jets (0-0-0) are projected to start Stuart Skinner in goal, with Clay Stevenson as backup, for their season opener against Boston. The team will have several debuts, including Isak Rosén, Viggo Björck, and Tyrel Bauer making their NHL first appearances. Notable absences include suspended starting goaltender Connor Hellebuyck (for not reporting to training camp) and injured defenders Elias Salomonsson (shoulder, expected back mid-October), Walker Duer, and Garrett Brown (both lower body).
